purpose: Determine whether the released policy can ground a self-distilled strategy from the identical solver-only fixture that failed with the base policy; separate policy-capability limitation from a shared input/rendering limitation.
historical_control: sglang_fixture_v1 (base model, original prompt); no control rerun
changed_factor: model and its associated processor from pinned b0 to pinned r0
fixed_factors: SFFF/FHHF/FFFF/FFFG, original 7 fixture frames and down3/right3 trajectory, original prompt including examples, 120px thumbnails with path, seed42, greedy, strategy256/reuse512 token limits, max5 reuse turns, SGLang Triton/vision SDPA
library: empty isolated fixture library; released library never loaded; fixture never used for training
metrics: strategy WHEN/WHAT grounding and direction/count correctness
interpretation: Success would support policy-specific capability as a cause, not establish base-policy E PASS. Failure would show this released policy also fails this diagnostic, not prove all local self-distillation impossible. Neither result authorizes PPO.
stop_rule: One generation and at most five reuse turns, no additional prompt, seed, sampling or checkpoint variants; preserve all failures. Original six-hour preparation attempt remains closed. This distinct checkpoint contrast is additionally capped by the unchanged original 24-hour clock.
